responsibility: Lists the non-vector builtin definitions for the RISC-V cache-management operation extensions, in table form consumed by riscv-builtins.cc. It maps Zicbom, Zicboz, and Zicbop operations to their builtin names, builtin-expansion kind, prototypes, and RV32/RV64 availability predicates, serving as declarative builtin inventory data rather than executable expansion logic.
